items.title: Gland Pharma shares jump 4% as Q2 profit jumps 58%, revenue rises 23% YoY
items.summary: Shares of Gland Pharma gained 3.89% to Rs 3,254.60 during Monday's trading session after the pharmaceutical company reported a strong performance for the September 2026 quarter, with revenue rising 23% year-on-year (YoY) and net profit surging 58%.The stock also touched a fresh 52-week high of Rs 3,345 during the session.Gland Pharma reported a 23% YoY increase in its Q2 revenue from operations to Rs 1,834 crore, from Rs 1,487 in the corresponding quarter of the previous year. Net profit for the September 2026 quarter rose 58% YoY to Rs 290.8 crore, compared with Rs 183.7 crore in the same quarter last year.The company's adjusted EBITDA increased 50% year-on-year, while the adjusted EBITDA margin stood at 27%. Its profit after tax (PAT) margin also expanded by approximately 350 basis points during the quarter.Business segment performanceGland Pharma's CDMO business contributed 45% to overall revenue and recorded 31% year-on-year growth in Q2 FY27. Meanwhile, its Critical Injectables business accounted for the remaining 55% of revenue, registering growth of 18% during the quarter.The company continued to invest in research and development, with total R&D expenditure reaching Rs 107.7 crore in Q2 FY27, equivalent to 6% of consolidated revenue. This was higher than Rs 81.7 crore reported in the year-ago quarter. The expenditure was primarily directed towards complex product development and increasing the number of regulatory filings.During the September quarter, Gland Pharma launched four molecules in the US market: Sugammadex, Erythromycin, Fluorouracil and Atropine Sulfate.The company also filed 11 Abbreviated New Drug Applications (ANDAs) and received 10 approvals during Q2 FY27. With these additions, its cumulative US ANDA filings reached 399, of which 350 had been approved and 49 were awaiting approval.Management commentaryCommenting on the quarterly performance, Srinivas Sadu, Executive Chairman of Gland Pharma, said the company delivered another quarter of strong growth, supported by improved execution across its businesses. He highlighted the 31% growth in the CDMO segment, driven by expanding customer engagements, strategic partnerships and a strong opportunity pipeline.He also noted that continued investments in manufacturing capabilities, innovation and capacity expansion would help the company capitalise on increasing global outsourcing opportunities and create long-term shareholder value.Gland Pharma share price Gland Pharma shares have gained approximately 30% over the past three months. The stock currently commands a market capitalisation of around Rs 51,928 crore.On the technical front, according to Trendlyne data, the stock is trading above seven of its eight simple moving averages (SMAs), indicating strength across most of its tracked moving-average indicators.Disclaimer: The views/recommendations mentioned in this article, wherever applicable, are those of the respective SEBI-registered Research Analyst/brokerage and have been reproduced/reported with due attribution. items.summary: Samir Arora backed Helios Mid Cap Fund has added Aurobindo Pharma and two other stocks in its portfolio in October and has increased its exposure in Paytm, Multi Commodity Exchange of India and 16 more stocks in the same period, according to the monthly portfolio disclosed on ACE MF.The fund added 2.54 lakh shares of Aurobindo Pharma in its portfolio worth a market value of Rs 42.74 crore. The fund added 11.77 lakh shares of Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses in its portfolio and this was followed by addition of 1.29 lakh shares of PVR Inox in the portfolio in October.The midcap fund added 27,200 stocks of One97 Communication (Paytm) in its portfolio taking the total count of shares to 5.10 lakh in October compared to 4.83 lakh shares in September. The fund added 51,430 shares of Multi Commodity Exchange of India in its portfolio and had 1.89 lakh shares in the said time period.Also Read | SIFs gain investor traction with over Rs 38,000 crore in assets. Should investors add them to their portfolios this Diwali?Among the other 16 stocks, the fund added the maximum number of shares of Ace Vector. The fund added 12.77 lakh shares of AceVector in its portfolio and had a total 47.77 lakh shares in its portfolio in October.This was followed by addition of 3.13 lakh shares of ITC Hotels in the portfolio and the fund had 11.17 lakh shares in its portfolio in October. The fund added 2.57 lakh shares of The Indian Hotels Company, 1.54 lakh shares of Gokaldas Exports, 1.05 lakh shares of AU Small Finance Bank and 86,600 shares of Ather Energy.The other 10 stocks where the fund increased its exposure were Siemens Energy India, Rentomojo, Bosch, Schaeffler India, GE Vernova T&D India, Radico Khaitan, Coforge, APL Apollo Tubes, Sona BLW Precision Forgings and 360 One Wam.A complete exit was made from Park Medi World by selling 4.89 lakh shares from the portfolio worth a market value of Rs 13.45 crore. items.summary:
Gland Pharma on Friday posted a 58.29 per cent rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 290.75 crore in the September quarter, driven by strong execution across businesses.
The company had reported a net profit of Rs 183.68 crore in the year-ago period.
The pharmaceutical company's revenue from operations rose to Rs 1,833.58 crore in the quarter under review from Rs 1,486.87 crore a year ago, the company said in a regulatory filing.
Total expenses also rose to Rs 1,471.69 crore in the July-September period from Rs 1,287.12 crore a year earlier, it said.
The company launched four molecules -- Sugammadex, Erythromycin, Fluorouracil and Atropine sulfate -- in the US this quarter, it said in a release.
